title: AI and ML Feature Integration Timeline and Cost Benchmarks
content:
AI and ML Feature Integration Timeline and Cost Benchmarks

Industry benchmarks for integrating AI/ML capabilities into software products.

## LLM / Generative AI Integration
- Basic LLM API integration (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude): 1–2 weeks
- Prompt engineering and response formatting: 1–3 weeks
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline: 3–6 weeks
- Fine-tuned model integration: 6–12 weeks (includes data prep)
- Full conversational AI feature set: 6–10 weeks

## Information Extraction & Search
- Keyword/rule-based extraction: 1–2 weeks
- NLP-based entity extraction (spaCy, Hugging Face): 2–4 weeks
- Semantic search with vector embeddings: 3–6 weeks
- Location/geospatial AI matching: 2–5 weeks

## Recommendation Engines
- Simple rules-based recommender: 1–3 weeks
- Collaborative filtering model: 4–8 weeks
- Deep learning recommender: 8–16 weeks

## ML Infrastructure
- Cloud ML pipeline setup (Vertex AI, SageMaker): 2–4 weeks
- Model monitoring and retraining pipeline: 3–6 weeks
- A/B testing infrastructure for models: 2–4 weeks

## AI/ML Engineer Rates (US Market, 2024)
- Junior AI/ML Engineer: $80–$110/hr
- Mid-level AI/ML Engineer: $110–$150/hr
- Senior AI/ML Engineer: $140–$200/hr
- Principal/Staff ML Engineer: $180–$250/hr
- AI/ML Consulting firm rate: $150–$300/hr

## Team Composition for AI Feature Development
- 1 AI/ML Engineer is typically sufficient for a single AI feature track
- Complex projects may need 2 AI engineers (one for model, one for infrastructure)
- AI work can proceed in parallel with backend development after API contracts are defined
- AI integration into frontend adds 1–3 weeks after backend AI APIs are stable

## Key Estimation Guidance
- A full AI-powered search and matching feature (like for a bereavement app finding funeral homes) realistically takes 6–10 weeks — NOT 12+ months
- AI core development does not need to be fully complete before frontend development begins
- Modern LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini) dramatically reduce AI development time vs. building custom models
- Use managed AI services (Vertex AI, OpenAI, Anthropic) to cut AI development time by 50–70%
